title: MechWarrior 2
description: Pilot a BattleMech in the 1995 demo. Let DOSBox unpack it on first launch, then follow setup. F1 shows the cockpit controls.
start:
config -set "cpu cycles=fixed 36000"
IF EXIST C:\MW2DEMO\VFX\VESA768.DLL GOTO PLAY
IF EXIST COMPRESS.EXE GOTO UNPACK
MECH2DEM.EXE
:UNPACK
MD C:\MW2DEMO
CD \MW2DEMO
C:\COMPRESS.EXE
:PLAY
config -set "cpu cycles=auto"
CD \MW2DEMO
IF EXIST SETUP.BAT CALL SETUP.BAT

title: The Incredible Machine
description: Build Rube Goldberg contraptions. Choose Play in Smart Start. If the screen stays dark after the intro loads, tap Esc.
start:
IF EXIST C:\DYNAMIX\TIM\TIM.EXE GOTO PLAY
INSTALL.COM
GOTO END
:PLAY
CD \DYNAMIX\TIM
TIM.EXE
:END

title: The Dig
description: The LucasArts sci-fi adventure demo. Tap Esc to skip the intro. GOG sells the full game.
start:
config -set "cpu cycles=fixed 10000"
config -set "render aspect=false"
config -set "render scaler=none"
mount d CD.ROM -t cdrom
d:
cd DEMOS\THEDIG
loadfix -25
THEDIG.EXE ic:\lecdemos\dig\
